title: Orientation Hub: Mini-playlists for first-time console use
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Problem: new users enter the Console and face a dense UI without clear next steps for creating their first inference route, exploring cost visibility, or understanding rollouts. Goal: design an 'Orientation Hub' that surfaces 2–3 bite-sized 'mini-playlists'—sequenced micro-lessons (tooltips, guided tasks, and templated snippets) tailored to user intent (Quick Prototype, Cost Check, Deploy a Canary). Each playlist is skippable, resumable, and context-aware (empty state -> anchor -> persistent sidebar). Success metrics: increase first-successful-deploy within 24h by 18%, reduce time-to-first-cost-insight by 25%, increase guided-tour completion NPS by +7.
design_goals: Minimal cognitive load: convert empty states into a clear starting point with a single CTA per playlist
Progressive disclosure: surface details only as the user proceeds through steps
Non-modal, non-blocking education: avoid interruptive modals; prefer inline anchors and collapsible sidecar
Resumability & analytics: allow users to pause and resume playlists; emit events for funnel analysis
Extensibility: permit product and growth teams to author new mini-playlists without engineering changes
work_items: Exploratory sketching: three orientation flows mapped to user intent
High-fidelity Figma prototype of empty canvas -> orientation hub -> stepper UI
Small tech spike with ENG to confirm event hooks and persistent state storage
Design spec and copy deck for each step, including microcopy for CTAs and microconfetti on first deploy
Usability test (n=8) with new signups and 3 task scenarios
A/B test implementation plan for full vs compact playlists
updates: 2026-02-20: Kickoff with PM and ENG. Alignment to prioritize three intent paths: Prototype, Cost Visibility, Canary Deploy. ENG raised concern about persistence storage for anonymous sessions; added dependency ENG-6122.

2026-02-26: First sketches reviewed. Decided on a right-side 'Orientation Hub' that expands from empty states and can be pinned. Trade-off: slight increase in chrome vs more discoverability. PM favored discoverability for new users.

2026-03-02: Figma prototype (link below) created. Added microplaylist stepper with optional code snippet insertion into a sandbox route. Design critiques: reduce step copy length, use progressive disclosure for advanced tips.
2026-03-04: Quick usability test (5 participants) — key finding: users liked short playlists but wanted a 'skip-to-deploy' action on step 2. Updated flows to add a 'deploy now' quick action.

2026-03-07: Engineering spike completed. ENG confirms telemetry hooks and local storage resume feasible; anonymous resume requires consent—added to copy and privacy checklist. ENG requested clear acceptance criteria for event names.

2026-03-10: PM review: suggested adding a cost-estimate card in the Cost Visibility playlist showing projected monthly spend. Design added lightweight estimate UI with link to detailed cost breakdown.

2026-03-12: Design review with Design Director. Minor UI polish requested (color contrast for stepper icons, animation timing). Preparing handoff assets and QA checklist. Planning A/B test with Growth team post-launch.
feedback_highlights: PM requested stronger incentive language for completing the Prototype playlist (added 'Deploy a working route in 5 minutes').
Eng suggested deferring heavy telemetry until A/B rollouts to avoid early data noise—we scoped minimal required events.
Research recommended an explicit 'Why this matters' microcopy on first step to reduce dropoff; added a 1-line benefit statement.
Design Director requested that empty-state illustrations be optional per brand theme to avoid SPoF in white-label deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Orientation Hub appears on Console empty states and is dismissible; pinning persists across sessions
Three production mini-playlists (Prototype, Cost Visibility, Canary Deploy) implemented in Figma and documented in the spec
Telemetry events documented and validated with ENG for resume, step_complete, playlist_complete, skip and pin actions
Usability test improvements validated (target: completion rate >= 70% in lab tasks)
A/B test plan created and ready for Growth to enable after release
next_steps: Deliver dev-ready component spec and token table to ENG (03/15)
Implement lightweight analytics schema and QA in staging (03/18)
Ship to 10% of new signups as a controlled rollout and monitor funnel (03/25)
Iterate on scope 2 based on metrics and qualitative feedback (April cycle)
